name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan has been a fixture in the motorsport catering scene for over two decades. Starting as a kitchen assistant at local racing events in Singapore, she quickly rose through the ranks, impressing with her meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage complex food service operations under pressure. Her passion for motorsport was ignited by her father, a lifelong fan of Formula 1, who instilled in her a deep appreciation for the dedication and precision required at all levels of the sport.

At Toyota Gazoo Racing, Mei Lian is responsible for ensuring that the entire team, from drivers to engineers, are well-fed and energized throughout race weekends. She works closely with nutritionists to develop customized meal plans tailored to individual dietary needs and performance goals. Mei Lian is known for her innovative approach to catering, incorporating local flavors and ingredients from each race location, adding a unique and memorable touch to the team's experience. She is a dedicated professional, always striving to exceed expectations and contribute to the team's overall success.

What truly sets Mei Lian apart is her unwavering commitment to quality and her ability to create a warm and welcoming atmosphere for everyone she serves. She believes that a well-fed team is a happy team, and she takes great pride in playing a vital role in their performance.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a practical bun
